name: {name}
workers_no_employed: There are no employed residents in the city
workers_no_unemployed: There are no unemployed residents in the city
builder_energy_description: With every new structure, your builders' efficiency drops. Give them time to rest, and they’ll get back to work at full capacity!
building_description_tower_gate: Once, a hermit lived in this house, but now we can use it as storage and a city gate. Watchmen can be assigned here to protect the city entrance from raiders.
building_description_floor_frame: Assembled from raw boards, the structure creaks and sways with every gust of wind and gives slightly under the weight of footsteps, but it is what allows the city to grow upward, unlocking space for new buildings.
building_description_pier: It used to be just a spot for fishing. Now, this pier helps haul in valuable resources — mostly debris from ships and the former civilization, like bottled candles, old boots, talisman cats, and those famous yellow ducks drifting past our city.
building_description_basic_elevator: This elevator regularly gets stuck between floors, forcing everyone inside to wait until someone rescues them. However, we have no alternative. Although... why don't we just build a regular staircase? Apparently, the blueprint for stairs is a lost technology of the ancients.
building_description_living_rooms: A peculiar hybrid of a bedroom, a closet, and a sock-drying rack. Still, there is a roof overhead, and it’s dry and draft-free inside. Expands the living area, allowing you to welcome more citizens.
building_description_coal_generator: If this machine produced energy with the same efficiency it belches clouds of dark smoke, we would have lit up the entire ocean by now. Alas, its efficiency is close to zero, but it is our only way to get at least some electricity for the city. Just keep feeding it firewood and don't breathe too deeply.
building_description_farm: In our reality, every centimeter of this soil is worth more than gold. Food is grown here to supply the city with fresh produce and keep the citizens from kicking the bucket on a dreary fish diet.
building_description_kitchen: A place where simple supplies are turned into a meal for the entire city. All dishes undergo strict control by the main city tasters—though these tasters are covered in fur, have long tails, and steal food right from the cutting board. As for sanitary standards, they are considered nothing more than a silly myth and an obstacle to culinary creativity.
building_description_weapon_workshop: The blacksmiths work without rest, drowning out any complaints from unhappy neighbors with the clatter of hammers. Outwardly, their creations look menacing, but the main secret of the local assembly is blue electrical tape, zip ties, and a piece of rusty wire. Provides the city with fresh gear.
building_description_resource_storage: Finally, a chance to apply school knowledge at this warehouse! Geometry to cram the uncrammable onto shelves, chemistry to scrub off mysterious stains, literature to prop up pallets with books... But physics was clearly ditched here, because this structure stands in defiance of its laws. Increases the overall resource capacity of the city. Just make sure not to pull out the bottom beam.
building_description_food_storage: There's no refrigerator, but there are rats. If they stop eating some stale smoked sausage, it means it's time to hand it out to the workers. Still, it allows storing much more provisions and increases the city's food supplies.
building_description_battery_room: Reliably stores generated energy. The main safety rule here: if a short circuit sets the wooden floor frames on fire, quickly act like it's planned city heating.
building_description_weapon_storage: Reliably hides weapons supplies away from thieves and casual onlookers. Truth be told, stepping in here without a helmet is a mortal sin: piles of rusty axes and swords tend to collapse at any attempt to grab something. And blades that slip off the shelves periodically fall from the upper floors — locals better not walk too close to the foot of the city, watch your heads! Increases the city's arsenal capacity.
item_description_wood: Plucked straight from the ocean. Wet, heavy, and smells faintly of seaweed, but once dried, it’ll make a fine floor for a new story. Just don’t think too hard about where the current carried it from.
item_description_stone: Heavy, rough, and completely uncompromising. Hauling it to the upper levels is a backbreaking joy, but a foundation built with this won't budge even in the fiercest ocean storm.
item_description_scrap: A chunk of someone's former ship or a sunken bridge. Looks like it’ll fall apart if you look at it wrong, but a few hammer taps and a good weld will reinforce your structures nicely.
item_description_plastic: Plastic doesn't sink, and it’ll outlive us all. The ideal material for lightweight walls and partitions — it won't rot from the sea mist and weighs next to nothing, which is crucial for high floors. The environment will thank us for taking it off its hands.
item_description_potato: The ultimate food for high-altitude living. Best served baked, but if push comes to shove, it’ll grow even in a pile of sawdust on the hundredth floor.
item_description_tomato: Juicy, red, and extremely fragile. Dropping it from the top floor is a culinary tragedy, but a magnificent spectacle for whoever is standing below.
item_description_cucumber: 95% water, scooped up and purified right in the middle of the ocean. Still, it delivers a satisfying crunch and is perfectly refreshing during a hot afternoon of building.
item_description_carrot: They say it improves your eyesight. And good eyesight is the only way to dodge falling construction debris in time.
item_description_cabbage: A multi-layered vegetable for a multi-story city. Every crunchy leaf is a small victory against scurvy and starvation.
item_description_baseball_bat: Baseball is dead, but this piece of sports equipment remains great for thoroughly explaining the house rules on the lower floors.
item_description_pipe: It used to carry water, but now it replaces bad intentions with immediate regret. Heavy, rusty, and extremely persuasive.
item_description_crowbar: Every survivor’s and builder’s best friend. Opens jammed hatches, nailed-shut crates, and the heads of anyone eyeing your resources.
item_description_hammer: Drives in nails, staples, and the realization that nobody lives in this city for free. Essential toolkit material for any floor.
item_description_hatchet: Small, but nasty. Perfect for trimming wooden beams down to size, and equally good at keeping unwanted visitors away from your tower in your downtime.
item_description_kitchen_knife: Too small to stop a rogue wave, but perfect for chopping veggies and precise cuts in tight corridors.
item_description_machete: A wide blade built for the jungle that adapted surprisingly well to an ocean city. Cuts through floating seaweed just as smoothly as it cuts through other people's demands.
item_description_fire_axe: A bright red symbol of hope designed to save lives. Though in the hands of an angry builder, it mostly saves your property.
item_description_sledgehammer: When delicate repairs fail, this steps in. Weighs as much as half your ground floor, but crushes arguments and walls in a single swing.
skill_description_cooking: Culinary mastery from minimal resources. Cooking speed is increased by {skillBonus}.
skill_description_farming: Secrets of gentle soil care. Crop maturation time is reduced by {skillBonus}.
skill_description_electrics: A deep understanding of amps and volts. Power generation efficiency is increased by {skillBonus}.
skill_description_crafting: Deft hands and blueprint expertise. Item and resource crafting is accelerated by {skillBonus}.
skill_description_boating: Flawless reading of currents and winds. Boat movement speed is increased by {skillBonus}.
skill_description_medicine: Knowledge of anatomy and emergency care. Health recovery speed is increased by {skillBonus}.
skill_description_science: A sharp mind driven by discovery. Skill leveling efficiency is boosted by {skillBonus}.
skill_description_combat: Composure in battle and a steady grip. Damage dealt is increased by {skillBonus} for all attacks.

tutorial_toolbox: The Toolbox is your command center for managing the city's systems.
tutorial_construction: Construction unlocks new buildings. Erect them to expand and develop your city.
tutorial_storage: The Storage shows all your city's resources and their limits. Keep an eye on your supplies - they are the foundation of prosperity.
tutorial_daily_tasks: Complete daily tasks and claim your rewards. New challenges await you every single day!
tutorial_daily_reward: Visit your city each day to claim a free reward.
tutorial_pier: The Pier opens the path to the ocean. Send your residents to hunt for drifting resources - it's one of the main sources of wealth.
